title: Godot's renderer isn't thread-safe when run in headless mode
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.4
Godot 4.7.1

### System information

Windows 11 64 bits Forward+

### Issue description

When you create `ArrayMesh` resources at runtime from different threads, it works fine. However, when that same project is run using `--headless`, it spams errors, sometimes crashes, despite the default thread model meant to be safe.
```
ERROR: Attempting to initialize the wrong RID
   at: (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:240)
ERROR: Parameter "mem" is null.
   at: initialize_rid (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:284)
ERROR: Parameter "m" is null.
   at: mesh_set_blend_shape_mode (servers/rendering/dummy/storage/mesh_storage.h:110)
ERROR: Parameter "m" is null.
   at: mesh_set_blend_shape_count (servers/rendering/dummy/storage/mesh_storage.h:74)
ERROR: Parameter "m" is null.
   at: mesh_add_surface (servers/rendering/dummy/storage/mesh_storage.h:81)
ERROR: Attempting to initialize the wrong RID
   at: (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:240)
ERROR: Parameter "mem" is null.
   at: initialize_rid (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:284)
ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID
   at: (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:247)
ERROR: Parameter "m" is null.
   at: mesh_set_blend_shape_mode (servers/rendering/dummy/storage/mesh_storage.h:110)
ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID
   at: (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:247)
ERROR: Parameter "m" is null.
   at: mesh_set_blend_shape_count (servers/rendering/dummy/storage/mesh_storage.h:74)
ERROR: Attempting to use an uninitialized RID
   at: (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:247)
ERROR: Parameter "m" is null.
   at: mesh_add_surface (servers/rendering/dummy/storage/mesh_storage.h:81)
ERROR: Attempting to initialize the wrong RID
   at: (./core/templates/rid_owner.h:240)
...
```
I expected Godot to behave fine as it did when not using `--headless`.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a new project
- Make an empty scene with a script that launches several threads and creates lots of `ArrayMesh` resources in them.
- Run the scene. Observe it runs without errors.
- Close Godot, then run the same project from the command line using `--headless`. Observe error spam.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[HeadlessRenderingThread.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30556632/HeadlessRenderingThread.zip)
